instruction: I want to set my current time zone to America/Los_Angeles. Can you help me?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting timezone to America/Los_Angeles. Evaluator checks timedatectl output for correct timezone string. Verified by checking timedatectl output format: line with 'Time zone:' contains timezone pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: Uses 'timedatectl status' command which is the standard Linux/Ubuntu command for checking timezone settings
Metric logic is correct: Properly parses timedatectl output by finding 'Time zone:' line and extracting timezone name before parenthesis
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in instruction (timezone = America/Los_Angeles)
Expected value is correct: 'America/Los_Angeles' is a valid IANA timezone identifier matching the instruction requirement
Practical feasibility: timedatectl is available on Ubuntu systems and output format is stable and well-documented
Good edge case handling: Returns 0.0 if 'Time zone:' line is not found, handles whitespace variations with strip()
